test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9b3d8b944bb168adb963a3ea1035d967fc5fc54acc6d6e70268bfd77812b4c5.png] 

 
 

 Cluster
 Positions
 1st to 2nd Shift
 2nd to 3rd Shift
 Pattern
 
 

 1) L H K
 L(12), H(8), K(11)
 8 - 12 = -4
 11 - 8 = +3
 -4, +3
 
 

 2) O K M
 O(15), K(11), M(13)
 11 - 15 = -4
 13 - 11 = +2
 -4, +2
 
 

 3) U Q T
 U(21), Q(17), T(20)
 17 - 21 = -4
 20 - 17 = +3
 -4, +3
 
 

 4) R N Q
 R(18), N(14), Q(17)
 14 - 18 = -4
 17 - 14 = +3
 -4, +3
 
 

The common pattern followed by LHK, UQT, and RNQ is a shift of -4, +3.

The cluster OKM follows a different pattern of -4, +2.

Therefore, the letter-cluster that does not belong to the group is OKM.
